headline: Junior AI-Native Software Engineer
summary: AI Engineering graduate with distinction who builds dependable Python backends, agent workflows, applied AI systems, and cloud-ready applications. Combines hands-on delivery across APIs, automation, data, and full-stack software with a pragmatic approach to testing and reliability. Ready to grow into an AI-native engineer who can connect technology to concrete business problems.
internship_bullets: Built a Python pipeline that reads echocardiographic DICOM studies, detects measurement regions, extracts values with OCR and image processing, and exports structured JSON.
Turned an open-ended research problem into resumable batch processing, validation queues, review tooling, structured logging, and a documented cross-platform handoff.
Optimised a source-video matcher with OpenCV ECC alignment and DICOM metadata, reducing one representative run from roughly 21 hours to 23 minutes.
apolloon_bullets: Built a local-first operations platform with React, TypeScript, Express, Electron, SQLite, tRPC, and Socket.IO for a real 24-hour running event.
Implemented operator workflows, API integration, LAN discovery, realtime synchronisation, health visibility, and replicated hot-standby failover.
